notice.title: Legal notice
notice.introduction: This notice sets out general information about the site and the basic rules governing access to Umbravia Forge during its development phase.

owner.title: 1. Site owner
owner.body: Umbravia Forge is owned and operated by Javier López Díaz. Umbravia Forge is currently a software project under development. The address, tax identification, any applicable registration details and a direct legal contact channel must be added here before the service is commercially released.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose
purpose.body: Umbravia Forge provides tools to browse classes, manage bookings and waitlists, and support sports-centre administration. Available features may change while the product remains under development.

intellectualProperty.title: 3. Intellectual and industrial property
intellectualProperty.body: Umbravia Forge's design, code, brand, text and other original elements are protected by applicable law. Access does not grant rights to reproduce, distribute, modify or exploit them unless expressly authorised or covered by an applicable licence.

links.title: 4. Third-party links and services
links.body: The application may include third-party links or integrations. Umbravia Forge does not control their content, availability or policies, and each external service is governed by its own terms.

liability.title: 5. Availability and liability
liability.body: Continuous availability and error-free operation are not guaranteed during development. Umbravia Forge will apply reasonable measures to protect and maintain the service, without excluding liabilities that cannot legally be excluded.

identityAndData.title: 6. Identity, identifiers and data
identityAndData.body: Umbravia Forge separates the account's internal identity, public support identifier, security credentials and secrets, operational data, and data that may be subject to restricted retention. The internal identifier maintains technical relationships; the public alias only helps authorized support locate the account; and only authorized credentials and verification can authenticate a person. A public identifier alone is never proof of identity or access.

law.title: 7. Applicable law
law.body: The final version must be adapted to the owner's actual activity, location and legal status, as well as the applicable e-commerce, consumer and data-protection rules.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.introduction: These terms describe the intended basis of the relationship between Umbravia Forge, sports centres and users. They are not yet final commercial terms.

scope.title: 1. Scope of the service
scope.body: Umbravia Forge supports the management of classes, users, trainers, bookings, capacity and waitlists. Each centre may configure parts of the service and is responsible for communicating its schedules, prices and specific rules.

accounts.title: 2. Registration and accounts
accounts.body: Users must provide accurate information and keep their credentials secure. Accounts are personal. Member, trainer and administrator permissions limit the actions available on the platform.

bookings.title: 3. Bookings and waitlists
bookings.body: A booking is subject to capacity and the rules set by the centre. When a place becomes available, the system may automatically promote the first person on the waitlist. The centre must disclose any additional attendance or priority rules.

payments.title: 4. Payments and plans
payments.body: Commercial payments are not enabled in this version of Umbravia Forge. Before Stripe or another provider is added, prices, taxes, invoicing, renewals, refunds and responsibilities among Umbravia Forge, the centre and the payment provider must be defined. Umbravia Forge will not store full card details.

cancellations.title: 5. Cancellations and termination
cancellations.body: Cancellation policies for classes, fees or subscriptions must be shown before a purchase or booking. The final version will explain deadlines, consequences, refunds and ways to cancel the service.

lifecycle.title: 6. Lifecycle, inactivity and account closure
lifecycle.body: The account owner can configure an inactivity preference, prepare selective data requests or request full closure. A closure request starts a reversible 30-day grace period and creates a technical job blocked for review; the current version does not execute automatic deletion or anonymization. Reactivation requires an authenticated action and relevant changes are recorded.

representation.title: 7. Continuity and limited representation
representation.body: The account and its identity are not transferred. The owner may prepare limited, revocable and scoped representation for hospitalization, incapacity or other contingencies. Future access depends on sufficient verification, applicable documentation and authorization; it never permits credential sharing, impersonation or automatic inheritance of account history. Requests concerning deceased persons will be handled under applicable law and valid instructions from the owner.

retention.title: 8. Deletion, anonymization and restricted retention
retention.body: Closing an account does not mean every category can be erased immediately. Profiles, preferences, sessions, authentication factors, future bookings and delegations are proposed for deletion or anonymization; billing, security, claims or hold records may be retained with restricted access where an applicable legal obligation or legal defence requires it. Final periods and grounds must be validated by category and jurisdiction. Internal policy review is not legal validation and never enables deletion.

changes.title: 9. Changes to these terms
changes.body: The terms may be updated when features or laws change. Material changes must be communicated clearly and, where appropriate, require renewed acceptance.

law.title: 10. Law and dispute resolution
law.body: Applicable law, competent courts and complaint mechanisms will be specified according to the owner's real location and activity, while always respecting mandatory consumer rights.

use.title: Conditions of use
use.introduction: These rules explain how to use Umbravia Forge safely and responsibly when managing classes, bookings and community activities.

access.title: 1. Access and security
access.body: Do not share credentials or attempt to access accounts, features or data without authorisation. Report suspicious activity and keep your account information up to date.

acceptableUse.title: 2. Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You may not interfere with the service, automate abusive requests, introduce malicious code, impersonate others, extract data without authorisation or use Umbravia Forge for unlawful activity.

bookings.title: 3. Responsible booking
bookings.body: Only book classes you reasonably expect to attend and cancel within the notice period set by the centre. Repeated misuse of bookings or waitlists may lead to proportionate restrictions that have been communicated in advance.

community.title: 4. Content and community
community.body: If comments are enabled, they must be used respectfully. Harassment, discrimination, threats, unlawful content and the publication of third-party personal data without permission are not allowed.

health.title: 5. Health and physical activity
health.body: Umbravia Forge organises information and bookings but does not provide medical advice. Each person must assess their health, follow professional guidance and inform the centre of relevant limitations before taking part in an activity.

availability.title: 6. Service availability
availability.body: Maintenance and interruptions may occur. Important bookings and changes must have suitable confirmation and recovery mechanisms before production use.

verification.title: 7. Human verification and sensitive forms
verification.body: Access, registration and authenticated forms that modify data may require recent human verification. The page and the API enforce the same condition. Disabling, automating, improperly reusing or bypassing verification is prohibited. If the provider cannot load or validate the response, the protected operation is rejected.

accountRecovery.title: 8. Account recovery and security
accountRecovery.body: Recovery, suspected-compromise review, session revocation, public-alias rotation and second-factor flows require stronger controls. The support alias does not authenticate. Users must review devices, passkeys and recovery methods, and report anomalies without sharing passwords or codes.

dataRequests.title: 9. Data and account requests
dataRequests.body: The owner can start full account closure from the privacy area. Before execution, Umbravia Forge verifies identity and authority, applies a grace period, classifies data, evaluates dependencies, retention and holds, reports the outcome and preserves suitable traceability. Cases subject to retention or centre ownership are blocked for review instead of being deleted automatically.

suspension.title: 10. Access suspension
suspension.body: Access may be restricted because of security risks, fraud, serious breaches or legal requirements. Measures must be proportionate and provide information and review options where appropriate.

privacyPolicy.title: Umbravia Forge privacy policy
privacyPolicy.pendingBody: Before public launch, the verified privacy channel, professional address, applicable identification and final processor and transfer inventory must be published. These details have not been invented.
privacyPolicy.introduction: This policy explains how personal data is processed in Umbravia Forge and UMF Support. It was checked against current code, migrations and tests; it does not itself prove that an external provider or server is active.

controller.title: 1. Controller and contact
controller.body: The controller for the platform's own processing is Javier López Díaz, owner of Umbravia Forge. A verified legal or privacy contact channel will be published here before public launch. Until it is validated, no address will be displayed that could create a false expectation of service.

roles.title: 2. Platform and facility responsibilities
roles.body: Umbravia Forge controls platform identity, security, contractual or pre-contractual relations, subscriptions and corporate support. Each facility may be an independent controller for its members' and staff data. A processing agreement is required where Umbravia Forge acts on a facility's instructions. UMF Support permissions are separate from facility permissions.

data.title: 3. Data processed
data.body: Depending on the features used: identity and contact details; password hashes, sessions, MFA, passkeys and security events; facility, role, classes, bookings, attendance and waitlists; community profiles, messages, attachments and moderation; minimum Stripe identifiers and states, without full card numbers; analytics, CRM and surveys; support tickets, email and audit trail; legal acceptance, retention and account closure. Health data and other special categories must not be entered in free-text fields.

purposes.title: 4. Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body: Data is used to create and secure accounts, provide contracted features, manage payment and billing, handle support and rights, prevent fraud and abuse, maintain continuity and comply with law. The bases are contract or pre-contractual steps, legal duties, legitimate interests in security, support and improvement, and consent where an optional feature requires it. Data is not sold or used for third-party advertising.

sources.title: 5. Sources and required data
sources.body: Data comes from the person, an authorised facility, platform use and necessary providers such as Stripe. A facility adding another person's data must have authority and inform that person. Required fields are needed for registration or the requested feature; failing to provide them may prevent that feature from being delivered.

recipients.title: 6. Recipients and providers
recipients.body: Access may be given to the selected facility and authorised staff, corporate staff with minimum permissions, contracted hosting, mail, network, security or operations providers, Stripe for payments, and authorities where required. The effective list of processors, purposes and locations will be published before public launch.

transfers.title: 7. International transfers
transfers.body: Transfers will occur only when necessary and supported by a valid mechanism, such as an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards. The final policy will identify providers outside the EEA and how safeguards can be obtained. Code for an integration does not prove it is active.

retention.title: 8. Retention and account closure
retention.body: Data is retained while the account, membership, contract, ticket or purpose remains active and afterwards according to tax, security, incident and legal-claim requirements. Closure applies a grace period and reviews dependencies, facility ownership, retention and holds. Erasure does not automatically remove data that must be retained or affects others' rights. Specific criteria must be approved before public launch.

rights.title: 9. Rights
rights.body: People may request access, correction, erasure, objection, restriction and portability where applicable, withdraw consent and complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency. Account controls support several operations. The public privacy mailbox will feed UMF Support and will be advertised only after inbound reception, ticket creation, reply and delivery are validated. Information may be requested to confirm identity.

minors.title: 10. Children
minors.body: Umbravia Forge is not designed for a child to enter a direct contractual relationship. A facility processing children's data must determine the applicable age, authority and consent, inform representatives and use the available parental controls.

security.title: 11. Security and confidentiality
security.body: Controls include server-side authorisation, facility separation, revocable sessions, optional MFA and passkeys, abuse limits, encryption of private fields and queues, integrity checks and audit trails. No measure removes all risk. UMF Support codes are one-time, expire and are stored only as hashes; corporate support shares neither permissions nor tables with each facility's member support.

cookies.title: 12. Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: Strictly necessary mechanisms support sessions, security, language and technical preferences. Cloudflare Turnstile may protect forms when configured. Non-essential advertising or analytics cookies will not be enabled without required information and consent.

changes.title: 13. Changes
changes.body: The date is updated only after checking the content against the real service. Material changes will be communicated and renewed acceptance requested where the legal basis or scope requires it.
